purpose: A command or agent prompt with a copy button, under hero or section copy ("npm create azion", "Ask your agent to …"). Both are a read-only block that wraps, so the reader sees every word they copy; with `shell` a decorative `$` prompt leads the command, which breaks anywhere (a command has no spaces to break at), and without it the agent prompt wraps between words. From the design sample's site `CopyCommandSection`.
useWhen: Use CopyCommandSection for a one-line command or agent prompt with a copy button on a marketing page.
The one command that starts a product, beside or instead of a call to action.
A prompt to paste into an AI agent (`shell` off).
avoidWhen: For several lines or output — use `CodeBlock` or `CliTerminalSection`.
bestPractices: One line that works when pasted as is.
Place it in a hero or module-header actions slot.
